781c3dec: ;
PURPOSE: This routine is used to edit fields in the Institution File (#393).
;DESCRIPTION: This routine provides the code to edit fields in the
;Institution File (#393). It handles the display, input, and validation
;of data for the fields in the file.
159bedca: ;Set up variables and call the DE subroutine
59434c43: ;Set up variables for editing and check if there is data in the sub-file
b7e2ab0a: ;If there is data in the zero node, get the current value of the field
91919228: ;Clean up variables
fbffe670: ;Display the field label and colon
7c29fd1b: ;Exit point for W subroutine
cbe7919a: ;Display the current value of the field and position the cursor
7d6fbeb2: ;Check if the field is too long for the current window size and word-wrap if needed
5bdaec7c: ;If the field is read-only, display a message indicating that editing is not allowed
1ca3b2f0: ;Read user input, handle timeout, and display a bell character if timeout occurs
35bf903a: ;Exit point for TR subroutine
08bd12a9: Initialize the question counter and increment it.
9946587b: Branch to the next question.
0d01a48a: Go to the computed RE (re-ask) label if the DE array is defined for this question, otherwise write DIE word-processing codes and execute the reader.

50895619: If no data was entered, go back to ask this question again unless this is a required field and either no data has been entered yet or the data is logically false. In the latter case, re-ask the question.
daa3181c: If the user enters a '?', go to the extended reader help. If the user enters '^' execute a DIE call.
51c48cc8: If the user enters '@', execute the Fileman ScreenMan called entry.

e02abbba: If the user enters a space, the field has the LAYGO property enabled, is not a Multiple-type field, and the template defaults source is defined for this field, use the defaults value for this field. Unless this is a Date or Set of Codes field, display the default response.
8cd49484: ;Display data name if no PL is defined and no conflict with 'S' xref.
cc920a0e: ;Loop through entries for current data type and display those not in conflict.
4a143940: ;Display remainder of data caption not in conflict.

2d1482a3: If the data value (DV) does not contain an asterisk '*', call the ^DIC routine to look up the value in the specified file and set X to the resulting internal entry number. If X is less than 0, quit.
b1cf57a0: If DV does not contain 'N', check if the length of the decimal part of X exceeds 24 characters. If so, set X to null and go to the label 'Z'.

5f2a69d2: If the second piece of DV (field type) is numeric and X contains a decimal point, but the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) (which represents field flags) does not contain a '$' (dollar sign), format X to remove leading and trailing zeros. If the decimal part of X is empty and X contains a decimal point, convert X to a number.
970d3e41: Kill the YS array node and invoke the COMPUTED FIELD CODE for the field.

4f8eaffa: If user input is defined and not a carrot (for delete), save it as a temporary value, store it in the DIE global for auditing if the field is audited, and skip to the A label to validate the input.
57425930: If the data is not valid, write a beep and jump to validation routine in DIE17.
e207765c: Set the user input to a standard '?BAD' error message.
09f073d4: Queue the input for processing by UPDATE(FILE for AUDIT so other users can see changes, ask UTILITY to validate the input and to update the database (FILE), then branch to the B label.
8669272d: Set up variables to hold field attributes for the field being edited.

07728907: If no Data Edit codes exist for this field, invoke the Output Transform for the field by branching to the RD label if the user did not enter an @, to the A label if the user entered an @ and the field is not a multiple, or to the X label if the user entered an @ and the field is a multiple. Otherwise, store the Output Transform result in Y and go to the N label.
796f790f: If there is Data Edit code, set up variables DG, Y and X, then execute the edit code.
57bae196: Point to selected file and get name, label, and global loc.
f4ea3da3: For selected entry get name, label, and global loc.
00148e4c: If set of codes, get new Y; else if sub dictionary, get entry from dict.

80424bae: ;Allow the input transform if it doesn't contain an I or #
a963509c: ;Call the code to edit fields and quit if successful or if data was protected.
228c8d57: ;Quit
35e380ff: ;Set initial variables for the .01 field
3df5161d: ;Set field attributes for the .01 field
22ec9360: ;Set the prefix for the lookup value
e97fd7a5: ;Go to the input transform
47a96b3e: ;Quit
d6d88d16: ;Call input transform for field 3
46b277ca: ;If the DGJTNUM variable doesn't contain a 3, set Y to null
d4ea7ffc: ;Quit
cda085e3: ;Call input transform for field 5
8817505c: ;If case does not involve Impairment exam, set Y to null.
ed5a399e: ;Quit routine if non-impairment case.
e928ae99: ;Re-run field computer on dirty fields if either DG or DG() array exists, then jump to DGJXE9 routine.
